preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Attacker must hold some INCOME tokens to sell

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setExtraFeeOnSell() with a value > 25 (e.g., 50) to set an excessive sell fee. Then sell tokens through the Uniswap pair to trigger the high fee mechanism. The contract will collect excessive fees during the sell transaction, which can later be withdrawn by the owner using SafeToken's withdrawBNB() function.
